source: ollama list on the same Windows laptop that ran the experiment
note: These are the 12-character short IDs that Ollama displays in `ollama list`. All four tags are the default Q4_K_M variants. The short IDs for llama3.1:8b and qwen2.5:7b match the prefixes of the full 64-character digests stored in environment.json at the start of the run. mistral:7b and gemma2:9b were pulled after that snapshot, so only these short IDs are available; full digests were not invented.
